template_data.headline_html: Which contract vehicle actually comes first.

items.title: GSA MAS
items.desc: Broadest coverage. Works across virtually all agencies. Often the prerequisite for other vehicles.

items.title: OASIS+
items.desc: Professional services only. Past performance required at application — the wall most skip over.

items.title: SEWP V
items.desc: IT products and services. Extremely competitive pool — check existing capacity before applying.

items.title: The real answer
items.desc: MAS first. Every time. The others are built on top of it, not instead of it.
